_readme: Every word of the community pack, in both languages. A copy change is a re-render:
edit here, run render.js, run verify.js. Never edit a PNG.
PUBLISH ORDER IS IN THE FILENAME AND IN THE FOLDER NAME.
seq        a global 01..15 running order across the whole pack
wave       the folder it renders into, itself numbered 00..06
notices    the bilingual language notice - ONE asset per format, not one
per language. It is the frame that says the French is coming, so
it cannot itself be in one language: it leads in FRENCH and puts
the English under it, dimmed. seq 01 belongs to it, which is why
the per-language posts start at 02 and the stories at 02.
So 03-stores-growing/priceback-community-09-post-en.png is the ninth thing
that goes out, and it is about stores. Neither number needs a spreadsheet to
read. schedule.json still owns the dates; this owns the ORDER, and the order
survives the dates being moved.
Rules verify.js enforces on this file:
- no claim window stated in days, in either language (see claims.js: the
window is per retailer, so one number printed here is wrong the day a
store with different terms goes live)
- no dollar figure, no percentage, no 'guarantee' / 'garanti'
- no implied partnership with, or endorsement by, a named retailer
- ANY frame naming a retailer must also carry `fineprint`, rendered on the
art itself. A caption disclaimer survives until the first screenshot.
- EN and FR carry identical seq, wave, layouts, accents, scenes, sticker
plans and row/step/check/hook counts
'__REDACTED__' in a row renders as an ink bar. That is compliance, not styling:
the pack never prints an amount it would have to stand behind.
ACCENTS: French RECEIPT ROWS are deliberately unaccented (PAYE, ECART, RECUS).
That is not an i18n slip and the checker will not flag it — thermal receipt
printers drop accents, so an accented row is the one thing on the paper that
would read as typeset rather than printed. Everything a PERSON writes — kickers,
hooks, sub-lines, captions, the status badge — is fully accented, because that
is the app speaking, not a receipt.
`reserve` is rendered but NOT scheduled: the strongest hooks from HOOKS.md that
did not fit the run. They carry an `id` (r1..r6) rather than a `seq`, and gate 9
does not see them - a reserve post has no place in the running order by
definition, and giving it one would be a lie the folder name tells.
Everything else applies to them unchanged: same gates, same claim rules, same
EN/FR parity.

storesLiveNote: COPY DESCRIBES PRODUCTION ONLY - the app's origin/main, which is what becomes
an APK. Never a development branch, never a feature that has not shipped.
So COSTCO is the one live store and BEST BUY IS COMING. Best Buy is promoted
on the development branch; in a store build the lab lane is as if it were not
there, and the receipt falls through to the generic parser - which is not the
same claim. This pack said 'TWO DOWN' and ticked both for one draft.
When a store ships to origin/main, tick it here in BOTH languages, update
05-highlights/facts.json, and re-render post 09, story 04 and reserve r4.
